basic_details.job_title: IGNTU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Research Assistant, Field Investigator Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi National Tribal University (IGNTU) has announced 2 project-based vacancies for Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts under an ICSSR-PVTGs sponsored project, with a maximum duration of 5 months. Qualifications vary by post, requiring a Post Graduate in Social Science with minimum 55% marks and specified additional criteria. The notified pay is Rs. 37,000 per month for the Research Assistant and Rs. 20,000 per month for the Field Investigator. Eligible candidates must apply by email by submitting the filled-in application form with bio-data and self-attested photocopies o

important_dates.application deadline: Within 21 days from the date of the advertisement

how_to_apply: Download the application form provided in the official notification PDF.
Fill out the application form completely along with a complete bio-data.
Gather self-attested photocopies of the required certificates.
Send the scanned copies of the duly filled-in application form, bio-data, and self-attested photocopies of required certificates via email to the Project Director at [email protected].
Ensure the application is sent within 21 days from the date of the advertisement.
important_instructions: A candidate should apply for one post only. Incomplete applications will not be considered. No TA/DA will be given to attending the interview. Selected candidates will not be permitted to claim any regular/part time appointments in this institute. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.

content_sections.heading: IGNTU Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be deployed for research duties associated with the project entitled “The Pastoral Legacy of the Todas: Arts, Culture, Education, Health and Livelihood of the Nilgiris Biosphere: An Ethnography Perspectives” under the Department of Education, Indira Gandhi National Tribal University Amarkantak, M.P.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be notified via email or telephone to appear for an online interview in accordance with ICSSR/IGNTU Project Management Guidelines. Candidates are required to appear online interview with a scanned copy of their curriculum vitae and all relevant original certificates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies available in IGNTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, comprising 1 post for Research Assistant and 1 post for Field Investigator.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit applications for IGNTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is within 21 days from the date of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Post Graduate in Social Science discipline with minimum 55% of marks with NET/JRF/M.Phil/PhD. A relaxation of 5% marks shall be granted to candidates belonging to SC/ST, as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Post Graduate in any Social Science disciplines with minimum 55% marks. A relaxation of 5% marks shall be granted to candidates belonging to SC/ST as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the Research Assistant position?
Q6. What is the monthly remuneration for the Field Investigator position?
Q7. How should candidates apply for these project posts?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates may apply by sending their duly filled-in application form, along with a complete bio-data and self-attested photocopies of the required certificates to the Project Director via email at [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is the appointment permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The post is purely temporary basis, with a maximum duration of 05 Months (May extent as per the field work requirement).

faq.question: Q9. How will shortlisted candidates be called for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be notified via email or telephone to appear for an online interview.
